heading: Today
text: Some patchy valley fog early, then mostly sunny.  Much less humid.   Highs in the upper 70s to low 80s.  Winds light, mainly west up to 10 mph, a few gusts to 20 mph in NH.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, with some high clouds south after midnight.  Areas of valley fog.  Lows in the 50s to low 60s.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Some patchy fog early.  Sun mixing with periods of clouds, more numerous south.  Seasonably warm.  Highs 80 to 85.  Winds light, tending to becoming south near 10 mph through the Champlain Valley.
